# C28 — the status generator that never existed

**Kind:** chore. No user-visible change — the app is not touched.
**Owner:** agent.
**Opened:** 2026-09-15, from `O42`, found by the F8 adversarial review.
**Branch:** `C28/the-status-generator`

---

## The defect

`docs/plans/00-status.md` opened with two lines:

```
<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_status.py — do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Regenerate: python3 scripts/gen_status.py   ·   CI: python3 scripts/gen_status.py --check -->
```

**`scripts/gen_status.py` did not exist.** Not in the working tree, not in any of 350 commits, not in
any branch — `git log --all --diff-filter=A -- '*gen_status*'` returned nothing. No file in
`.github/`, `scripts/` or `.githooks/` referenced it, or the page it claimed to produce.

So the project's single status artifact was hand-written prose wearing a generated file's header, and
that header told every reader not to correct it.

**What it cost, concretely.** The page reported `F8` as *"plan written, **awaiting the gate.** No code
has been written"* for six days while six `F8` commits sat on `main`. It reported **1 decision** while
`00-deltas.md` held 36. Row `F11`'s status was truncated mid-word — *"plan written, \*\*awaiting the
gate"* — which reads as a status rather than as damage. Nothing was ever going to notice any of it.

**A second one, found on the way and not fixed here.** `00-register.md`'s own header says it is
*"Regenerated by `scripts/extract_zenpom.py`, which MERGES"*. That script does not exist in this
repository either. It is an upstream corpus tool and the register is maintained by hand here. Left
alone deliberately — this chore fixes the page it was opened for, and a second phantom-generator claim
is a separate decision about a file with different provenance. Recorded so it is not rediscovered.

---

## What was built

**`scripts/gen_status.py`** — reads `docs/plans/00-register.md`, every plan in `docs/plans/` and
`docs/chores/`, and the specs in `docs/specs/`. Writes the page, or with `--check` exits 1 and prints a
unified diff when the committed page is not what a fresh run produces.

### The three rules it is written to

**1 · Nothing comes from git, and there is no date.** A generated file that embeds anything moving on
its own can never compare equal to a regeneration of itself, so `--check` would fail for a reason
nobody caused. The page's own preamble already said this and it is now enforced by the code rather than
asserted by the prose.

**2 · Where a source is silent, the page is silent.** An absent plan status renders `—`; an absent
register status renders `unknown`, and `unknown` is counted separately from `open`. This is the defect
`conventions.md` names twice — a register parser that returned `title='ratified'` for every row while
fifteen assertions passed, and a status page that reported `open` for rows nobody had given a status.

**3 · It refuses to substitute a nearby line for a missing one.** The old page printed `SPEC.md`'s
`**Status:** DRAFT for ratification…` under the heading *The vision sentence*. That is not a vision
sentence. The generator looks only under a `## The vision sentence` heading and says plainly when no
spec declares one — a wrong answer under a confident label is worse than an absent one, because nobody
re-checks it.

### Two parsing details that are load-bearing

- **Rows are keyed by the table's own header cells**, so a renamed or inserted column makes the lookup
  miss and the value render as unknown, rather than silently mapping onto the wrong field.
- **A register's symbol comes from its heading's parenthesis**, `## Owner items (O)`, not from the IDs
  inside it — so a section with mis-prefixed rows shows as a section with the wrong rows rather than
  being quietly redistributed into the right-looking places.

---

## Verification — the gate exists in three places, and each was broken on purpose

| # | Surface | Command |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `make` | `make status` writes · `make check-status` verifies |
| 2 | pre-commit | `run_check "00-status.md is current"` — after the last edit, per `conventions.md` |
| 3 | CI | step *"The status page is generated, not hand-written"* |

**Four tests in `scripts/tests/run-script-tests.sh`**, all against a fixture repository in a temporary
directory, never this one:

| Test | What it proves |
|---|---|
| `statusCheckPassesWhenGenerated` | `--check` passes on a page it just wrote — a check that cannot pass gets removed from CI |
| `statusCheckCatchesAHandEdit` | a line appended by hand fails `--check` |
| `statusCheckCatchesAStalePage` | a register edited without regenerating fails `--check` — the real-world case, and the one `O42` describes |
| `statusPageDoesNotGuessAnAbsentStatus` | a row with an empty status counts as `unknown`, never `open`, and does not appear in the open table |

**`statusCheckCatchesAHandEdit` failed the first time it was run**, because its own mutation — a `perl`
substitution — silently matched nothing, so the page was unedited and `--check` correctly passed. The
test now asserts that its mutation changed the file before asserting anything about the result. *An
assertion whose setup failed proves nothing*, and this one proved it in the only way that counts.

**`statusPageDoesNotGuessAnAbsentStatus` is written against a fixture where the three rows differ** —
one open, one closed, one blank. A parser returning a single value for every row fails the count. A
fixture where all three agreed would have distinguished nothing.

### Mutations run against the shipped code, not argued

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `C28-M1` · append a hand-written line to `00-status.md` | **caught** — `make check-status` exits 1 |
| `C28-M2` · flip `O43` from `open` to `closed` in the register and do not regenerate | **caught** — exits 1 from a verified-green baseline |
| `C28-M3` · delete `scripts/gen_status.py` | **caught** — an absent generator fails the gate rather than skipping it |

`C28-M2` was run twice. The first run was invalid: an earlier mutation's cleanup had restored the
*old committed* page, so the check was passing judgement on a file that was already stale for another
reason. It was re-run from a confirmed-green baseline, and only the second run is evidence.

```
scripts/tests/run-script-tests.sh: 19 passed, 0 failed
make check-status: OK — 00-status.md is up to date.
```

---

## What this does not do

- **It does not decide what the page should contain.** The sections are the ones the page already had,
  minus `Milestone` — no source in this repository declares which milestone a unit belongs to, and the
  old page said so itself before printing an empty row for it. A column every source is silent about is
  not information.
- **It does not read git**, by design. See rule 1.
- **It does not fix `docs/reviews/OPEN.md`** (`O44`), which is the same class of problem — an aggregate
  maintained by hand that has drifted from the register. Now that a generator exists and is enforced,
  generating `OPEN.md` the same way is the obvious next move, and it is a separate chore.
